review_notes: message_inbox lists unread, unarchived mail, including delivered rows; injection retains undelivered-only CAS delivery. Supervisor aliases resolve to the current named session mailbox. Only transport help changes; argument schema, effects and return protocol remain unchanged.

previous.name: message_inbox
previous.description: List the pending (undelivered) messages for one recipient.  With inject=true it also marks them delivered and archives any rows flagged archive_after_inject.  include_consumed additionally returns rows already delivered to this recipient, read-only, so a worker whose inject consumed delivery before it could render the bodies can still read them.

include_consumed.description: Also return already-consumed messages (read-only; never changes delivery state)

limit.description: Max rows (default 50, or max_inject_per_prompt when injecting)

current.name: message_inbox
current.description: List unread, unarchived messages for one recipient, including already-delivered mail. Supervisor aliases and the current named session UUID share an inbox. With inject=true, return only undelivered messages, mark them delivered and archive any rows flagged archive_after_inject.  include_consumed additionally returns other consumed rows for this recipient, read-only, so a worker whose inject consumed delivery before it could render the bodies can still read them.

include_consumed.description: Also return already-consumed messages (read-only; never changes delivery state)

limit.description: Max rows (default 50, or max_inject_per_prompt when injecting)
